name: Tiras
overview: Tiras is a male biblical figure identified as a son of Japheth, according to Genesis 10:2. Beyond this lineage, Scripture does not provide further details about his tribe or additional attributes. His mention situates him within the genealogical records that trace the descendants of Noah's sons.
namesAndTitles: The name Tiras appears as a proper name in Scripture without a given meaning or divine origin noted. It is simply recorded as the name of this individual in Genesis 10:2, without further explanation or titles.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Tiras as a son of Japheth, making him part of the broader family descended from Noah. No other familial relationships or descendants are specified in the biblical text beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Tiras holds significance as part of the genealogical framework that outlines the nations and peoples descending from Noah's sons after the flood. His inclusion in Genesis 10:2 places him among the foundational figures through whom God preserved humanity and fulfilled His covenant. Though not elaborated upon, Tiras contributes to the biblical understanding of the spread of nations under God's sovereign plan.
